description: Image Description: The image shows a small, white private jet parked on a wet tarmac, likely after rainfall, as the ground is reflective and puddles are visible. The aircraft has a sleek design with a pointed nose, a T-tail configuration, and two rear-mounted engines. The registration number "PH-TXI" is clearly marked in black on the tail fin. The side of the fuselage features a thin red stripe running along its length. The cockpit door is open, revealing the interior
